user_query: Under which condition does the second-order proximity between two vertices become 0, and how is this condition stated in terms of their shared links?
llm_response: The second-order proximity between two vertices becomes 0 when they have no shared links at all. In other words, the condition is that the two vertices share no common neighbors (their shared-link set is empty).
llm_confidence_reasoning: This is a standard definition of second-order proximity: it is zero when there are no common neighbors/shared links between the two vertices.
